Chapter 745: Chapter 30: The Heavenly Gate Appears (Subscription Request)_3

Chapter 745: Chapter 30: The Heavenly Gate Appears (Subscription Request)_3

“Let’s begin the selection then,” nodded the Four Divine Kings.

The very next moment.

A terrifying presence, with the Four Divine Kings at its center, swept through in all directions. At the same time, four or five other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives also freely released their own auras.

In an instant, a horrifying suppressive force enveloped the pinnacle of Heavenly Mountain, and all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses felt a vast force bearing down upon them.

“What’s going on?”

“What are the Four Divine Kings doing?”

...

“They’re cleansing the field. The Four Divine Kings are cleansing the field,”

Some of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses immediately realized something, their faces turning ugly.

“From now on, only those who can withstand our pressure for the time it takes an incense stick to burn will have the right to stand atop Heavenly Mountain,” came the cold voice of the Four Divine Kings.

With their strength, if they joined forces with other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, they could completely massacre the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses present.

But doing so would inevitably offend the forces behind these powerhouses.

After two to three hundred years of hunting, the surviving powerhouses of the Myriad Clans had grown wise and would not carry treasures on their person.

If it were for treasures, the Four Divine Kings wouldn’t mind stirring up a massacre, but slaughtering these powerhouses of the Myriad Clans now was completely pointless.

Hence, the Four Divine Kings and other powerhouses chose to cleanse the field.

“Stand for the time it takes an incense stick to burn?”

“I feel like I can’t even withstand it for ten breaths.”

Some of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses were trembling in their legs, not hesitating in the least to exit the range of the mountain summit.

“After three hundred years of hard cultivation, I’ve finally reached the Witch Ancestor’s Tenth Realm, only to find I don’t even have the right to watch the Heavenly Gate open from the summit,” said a powerhouse of the Myriad Clans, his expression dejected. He was a Tenth Rank Powerhouse in the outside world and had thought that falling into the Two-dimensional World

would be an opportunity for him. After all, even Eleventh-Rank Lives would be starting from the same point as him, but he hadn’t expected the gap to still be so unimaginably big.

“Such a terrifying pressure, what Realm are the Four Divine Kings really at?”

A certain Eleventh Rank Powerhouse looked serious. He was confident he could withstand the pressure for the time it takes an incense stick to burn, but this was merely the pressure released by the Four Divine Kings.

Struggling so hard against the Four Divine Kings’ pressure, what hope did he have when facing their actual killing intent, let alone competing for a spot through the Heavenly Gate.

…

“The Four Divine Kings have cultivated at least to the Witch Ancestor Thirtieth Realm…” mused a grim Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouse standing there. He was an Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier Powerhouse, and it was easy for him to withstand the length of an incense stick under the pressure of the Four Divine Kings.

But from the aura and suppressive force emitted by the Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, one could vaguely estimate the true strength of the Four Divine Kings.

…

On the side of Human Civilization.

Lin Yuan stood quietly, his expression calm and without the slightest fluctuation.

The Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives joining forces to clear the field did not cross Lin Yuan’s bottom line.

He even preferred to watch this scene, taking the opportunity to observe the true strength of the Four Divine Kings and other powerhouses.

“Although they have released their auras, they have not yet activated that supreme weapon,” Lin Yuan thought, gazing distantly at the Four Divine Kings.

“Let’s wait and see.”

Lin Yuan was not in a hurry, wanting to see the Four Divine Kings use that supreme weapon before deciding whether he should compete for a spot through the Heavenly Gate this time.

“You all?”

Lin Yuan glanced at his surroundings. At this moment, apart from Xuanyuan Dua and others, the Evolvers of Human Civilization looked somewhat strained.

They would likely struggle to withstand it for the time it takes an incense stick to burn.

Under the combined suppressive force of the Four Divine Kings and the few other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses below the Witch Ancestor Eighteenth Realm could hardly hold on.

Especially Nalan, who had turned red in the face. As a newly promoted Eleventh-Rank Evolver, he probably couldn’t last even half the time it takes an incense stick to burn.

“Don’t be distracted.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan began to help them bear the pressure.

Suddenly.

The faces of Xuanyuan Dua and other Evolvers relaxed considerably.

“Thank you, Lord Xueyu,” Xuanyuan Dua and the others immediately expressed their gratitude.

…

“Hmm?”

At the central summit, the Four Divine Kings appeared slightly astonished as they looked towards the side of Human Civilization.

“Interesting.”

The Four Divine Kings faintly felt that the pressure they had released was being invisibly diluted as it encountered the vicinity of the Human Civilization Evolvers.

Accomplishing this was far more difficult than simply resisting his pressure.

“This Evolver from Human Civilization shouldn’t be underestimated,” the Four Divine Kings thought highly of Lin Yuan for a moment, but then ceased to pay attention.

To them, Lin Yuan at most was on the same level as that skinny old man, an Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Life, and not a threat to them at their current level.

Soon enough.

The time of an incense stick was almost up.

At this moment, the summit of Heavenly Mountain, originally having tens of thousands of Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, had plummeted to fewer than 300.

Most of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses had been driven to the mountainside, able to see the summit only from a great distance.

“The Four Divine Kings are too tyrannical.”

“We’re not even trying to get close to the Heavenly Gate, so why clear us out like this?”

“If you think the Four Divine Kings are tyrannical, you can go challenge them.”

…

The many Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses driven down from the summit showed discontent on their faces, but dared not take any rash actions.

If at the beginning of their descent into this Two-dimensional World, they had hoped to threaten the likes of the Four Divine Kings by joining forces,

then after more than three hundred years have passed, powerhouses like the Four Divine Kings have long since grown, far beyond what they could contend against with numbers.

Thus, the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses below the summit were discontented, but not daring to take a step back onto the summit.

Soon enough.

The time of an incense stick had passed.

Atop the summit, there were only just over a hundred Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses left.

All were Eleventh Rank Powerhouses.

“Now it’s much quieter.”

The Four Divine Kings looked around with satisfaction and sat down cross-legged once again.

In the distance, the four or five Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives also nodded slightly.

Even though they were planning to join forces against the Four Divine Kings, the notion of ‘weak ones having no right to stand atop Heavenly Mountain and wait for the Heavenly Gate to open with them’ still coincided with the Four Divine Kings without prior agreement.

Lin Yuan and Xuanyuan Dua, along with the other Human Civilization Evolvers, also stood in their places waiting.

Time slowly passed by.

In the blink of an eye, another half a month had gone.

On that day,

under the gaze of all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses on the summit, a grand spatial fluctuation began to converge in the sky above the summit.
